$schema_note: MTower Studio — training-set recipe for prop models (LoRAs). Each variation is one FLUX.1 Kontext edit of a real reference photo in media/library/props/<PRP-ID>_<slug>/references/. {NAME} is replaced by the prop's name. Per-prop 'training_actions' in props.json are added to these.
identity_lock: Keep the {NAME} exactly as in the photo: the same shape, proportions, parts, colour and markings. Do not redesign, simplify, or add parts. No text, letters, or numbers anywhere; no photo border or rounded corners. Realistic photograph, 1970s.

variations.edit: Show only the {NAME}, alone, in side view on a plain light grey background, evenly lit, no people
variations.caption: side view, alone on a plain grey background

variations.edit: Show only the {NAME}, alone, in three-quarter view from slightly above on a plain light grey background, no people
variations.caption: three-quarter view from above, alone on a plain grey background

variations.edit: Place the {NAME} alone on flat desert sand in bright midday sun with hard shadows, no people
variations.caption: lying on desert sand in bright midday sun

variations.edit: Place the {NAME} alone on a wet salt flat at night under cold blue moonlight, no people
variations.caption: on a wet salt flat at night in moonlight

variations.caption: on sand at dusk in low red light

variations.caption: close-up detail

variations.caption: top-down view lying on sand
